title: Faithful flatness of finite-type algebraic-to-analytic local rings

items.title: Faithful flatness of finite-type algebraic-to-analytic local rings
items.statement: Assume AC. Let X be a finite-type complex scheme, x a complex closed point, and define X^an locally by extending a finite polynomial defining ideal to convergent holomorphic functions, retaining nilpotents. The canonical local map A=O_{X,x}→B=O_{X^an,x} is injective and faithfully flat; its induced map on maximal-ideal completions is an isomorphism. In Serre’s flat-pair convention, B/A is flat over A and M→M⊗_A B is injective for every A-module M. On an affine ambient chart at x, C[t]_(t) and C{t} have common completion C[[t]], and the quotient comparison is compatible with every finitely generated defining ideal. This is a local-ring assertion, not a relative direct-image theorem.
items.strategy: Identify finite jets on polynomial local and convergent rings by truncation and finite degree-k monomial grouping of convergent tails. Apply existing completion flatness: T is flat over A and faithfully flat over B. For each injection of A-modules tensor its B-kernel with T, use A-flatness of T and faithful reflection to get zero kernel. Prove local faithfulness and unit injection, then Tor gives B/A flat. Pass to the same extended defining ideal for finite-type quotients; do not invoke reduced-set Nullstellensatz.
items.axiom_base: ZF + full AC; record resolutions, countable shrinking/diagonal choices, Baire/Fréchet arguments and supplier-inherited choice uses precisely. No physical premise.

references.title: Serre
references.locator: §6 Proposition3/Corollary1 printed pp.9–11; Annex Propositions22–23,27–29 printed pp.36–40; read.

title: Faithful flatness of finite-type algebraic-to-analytic local rings — Examples

items.title: Unequal local rings with equal completions
items.statement: C[t]_(t)→C{t} is faithfully flat with common completion C[[t]], but is not surjective.
items.strategy: Use a convergent nonrational germ, e.g. exp(t), and prove its nonrationality.
items.axiom_base: ZF + AC inherited from the theorem; no physical premise.

items.title: Faithful flatness retaining a nilpotent thickening
items.statement: C[x,y]_(x,y)/(x^2)→C{x,y}/(x^2) is faithfully flat and retains the nonzero nilpotent class x.
items.strategy: Apply quotient flatness and verify x≠0; do not replace by reduced vanishing sets.
